name: MultiTableInsertWhenClause
docs:
A WHEN clause in a conditional multi-table INSERT.

Syntax:
```sql
WHEN n1 > 100 THEN
  INTO t1
  INTO t2 (c1, c2) VALUES (n1, n2)
```
